notes.title: Mida's Adventure v1.1 Update!
notes.notes:
Mida's Adventure has been updated to version 1.1!

This update includes:
- New Original Music
- New Sound Effects
- Achievements
- Cloud Saving
- "Game Over" Continue Option
- Improved BGM & SFX Options
- Level Tweaks

Some of you have mentioned finding things a bit challenging, so we've added an option to continue from the current level when getting a "Game Over". You'll lose some points if you choose to continue, so the highest scores will still be achieved by getting by without it.

Speaking of achieving, you can now go for 11 new achievements!
And you can do that while listening to new original music by YoshiOST!

We hope you enjoy the changes. ^.^

-Recall Software
